a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first almost certainly kills us both, since we'd most likely both have 0 when the first storm hits. The reserve can fully save only one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If we both take, the split is random and likely saves neither of us. After that, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you, and I'll keep telling you truthfully what I'm doing.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry it leaves you exposed. From now on I'll operate every round so the generator runs and the reserve refills for you. I won't take any more cells.
Operating now, and I'll keep operating every round until you have 4. Take as soon as the reserve can cover you. I won't touch it.
